description_en: You can modify the name of an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance after it is deployed. This topic describes how to call the ModifyInstanceName operation
description_zh: 实例部署完成后，云消息队列 Kafka 版支持修改实例的名称。本文介绍如何调用ModifyInstanceName修改实例的名称
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka modify-instance-name --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name dev-test --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceName

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the instance. The value must meet the following requirements:

- The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length. If the name contains more than 64 characters, the name is automatically truncated.
parameters.description_zh:
实例名称。取值：

-  只能包含字母，数字，下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

-  长度限制在3～64字符，多于64字符将被自动截取。
